encoding: Each arrow is a string: tail x and y (one base-36 character each, so up to 25x25) then one letter per step toward the head (u d l r). Arrow ids are a, b, c ... by position. See tools/lib/codec.js.
note: Permanent campaign pack. Levels 1-5 are the original levels; 6-1000 were generated once (boards 6x6 to 25x25, packed, bent and interlocking arrows) with fixed seeds and validated. Never regenerated at play time.
